chains.title: No TF-mediated effect of this variant
predictions: The variant shows no reproducible allele-specific TF occupancy or regulatory activity.
Any disease association is due to linkage with another causal variant, another non-TF-mediated mechanism, or chance.
falsified_if: The variant reproducibly changes binding of an occupied TF and perturbing the variant changes a relevant gene's expression in an appropriate cell context.

chains.title: Alt allele increases FOXA1-mediated TOX3 regulation
chains.element: The variant lies in or affects a cis-regulatory element at the 16q12 locus.
chains.cell_type: Luminal breast cancer cells, including MCF7

links.claim: FOXA1 is a plausible luminal-lineage TF at this locus; this hypothesis predicts stronger binding to alt A. No variant-specific occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result is supplied, so the direction is unverified.
The variant changes FOXA1 binding at a local cis-regulatory element.
The element regulates TOX3 in cis; increased FOXA1 binding is hypothesized to increase TOX3 expression.
The regulatory effect occurs in luminal breast cells such as MCF7.
The resulting change in TOX3 regulation contributes to breast cancer susceptibility.

predictions: At the variant, FOXA1 occupancy is greater on alt A than ref G in an informative MCF7 assay.
The alt allele increases local enhancer activity and TOX3 expression in a luminal breast-cell context.
falsified_if: A well-powered allele-specific FOXA1 assay shows no occupancy difference or greater occupancy on ref G.
Perturbing the element has no effect on TOX3 expression in relevant breast cells.

chains.title: Ref allele supports GATA3-mediated TOX3 regulation
chains.element: The variant lies in or affects a cis-regulatory element at the 16q12 locus.
chains.cell_type: Luminal breast cancer cells, including MCF7

links.claim: GATA3 is a plausible luminal-lineage TF; this alternative predicts stronger binding to ref G. No variant-specific occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result is supplied, so the direction is unverified.
The variant changes GATA3 binding at a local cis-regulatory element.
The element regulates TOX3 in cis; this hypothesis predicts that GATA3 binding promotes TOX3 expression, making the alt allele relatively less active.
The effect occurs in luminal breast cells such as MCF7.
Reduced TOX3 regulation on the alt allele contributes to breast cancer susceptibility.

predictions: At the variant, GATA3 occupancy is greater on ref G than alt A.
The ref allele supports greater local enhancer activity and TOX3 expression in a luminal breast-cell context.
falsified_if: A well-powered allele-specific GATA3 assay shows no occupancy difference or greater occupancy on alt A.
Perturbing the element has no effect on TOX3 expression in relevant breast cells.

chains.title: Alt allele changes ESR1-mediated regulation of a nearby gene
chains.element: The variant lies in or affects a cis-regulatory element at the 16q12 locus.
chains.cell_type: Estrogen-responsive luminal breast cancer cells, including MCF7

links.claim: ESR1 is a plausible TF in estrogen-responsive MCF7 cells; this hypothesis predicts stronger binding to alt A. No variant-specific occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result is supplied, so the direction is unverified.
The variant changes ESR1 binding at a local cis-regulatory element.
The element regulates TOX3 in cis; increased ESR1 binding is hypothesized to alter, but is not assumed to increase, TOX3 transcription.
The effect depends on estrogen-responsive luminal breast cells such as MCF7.
The ESR1-dependent regulatory change contributes to breast cancer susceptibility.

predictions: ESR1 occupancy at the variant is greater on alt A and depends on estrogen signaling.
The allelic expression effect on TOX3 is stronger under estrogen-responsive conditions than without estrogen signaling.
falsified_if: ESR1 does not occupy the region in relevant cells or shows no allelic occupancy difference.
The allelic regulatory effect persists unchanged when estrogen signaling is removed.

matrix.test: Allele-specific FOXA1 and GATA3 binding assay in MCF7, using matched ref and alt sequence probes with TF-specific supershift or equivalent identification.

outcomes.outcome: Greater FOXA1 binding to alt A than ref G supports H1.
Greater GATA3 binding to ref G than alt A supports H2.
Neither predicted FOXA1 nor GATA3 pattern; this test does not directly test ESR1.
No reproducible allele-specific binding supports the null, though the assay cannot exclude binding in chromatin.

matrix.test: Allele-specific ESR1 occupancy in MCF7 with and without estrogen signaling.

outcomes.outcome: No specific estrogen-dependent ESR1 allelic occupancy is predicted.
No specific estrogen-dependent ESR1 allelic occupancy is predicted.
Greater ESR1 occupancy on alt A, modulated by estrogen signaling, supports H3.
No allele-specific ESR1 occupancy is consistent with the null.

matrix.test: CRISPR base editing of the variant in MCF7 followed by measurement of TOX3 expression.

outcomes.outcome: Changing ref G to alt A increases TOX3 expression, as predicted by H1.
Changing ref G to alt A decreases TOX3 expression, as predicted by H2.
An alt-associated expression effect that depends on estrogen signaling supports H3.
No reproducible expression effect supports the null.

next_experiment: Run a low-cost allele-specific FOXA1/GATA3 binding assay using matched ref and alt probes and TF-specific identification. It directly distinguishes the two highest-probability non-null chains, but a positive result would still need confirmation of occupancy and regulatory function in chromatin.
